full_judgment: ATM Afzal CJ: These six appeals by the pre-emptor appellants, following leave, arise out of a judgment and order dated 21 July, 1985 passed by a Single Judge of the High Court Division (at Comilla) making the Rules absolute in Civil Revision Nos. 40-45 of 1985 and restoring the judgment and order of the trial Court after setting aside those of the lower appellate Court passed in six pre-emption cases filed by the appellants under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 against six different sets of opposite-party-respondents.
